items.title: Nvidia chips stockpile in Hong Kong awaits China import approval - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- About 600,000 Nvidia artificial intelligence chips are stored in Hong Kong waiting for shipment to mainland China, Reuters reported Thursday citing people familiar with the matter. Beijing has not approved large-scale imports of the H200 chips despite demand from technology companies.

items.title: America just voted against AI. That might be good.
items.summary: Voters pushed back on AI data centers this week, and Goldman Sachs warns 45% of planned US capacity could be affected. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down why voters turned on data centers, Texas's new conditions, the market's split reaction and why an AI bull thinks a slower buildout might be good for AI.

items.title: Massive market rotation raises question: Is the sell-AI trade here to stay?
items.summary: Investing.com - Tech saw a sharp rotation into hyperscalers on Wednesday, while semiconductors and data center infrastructure stocks came under pressure as a Democratic election win triggered a huge thematic rotation. Amazon rose 6.1% on the session, Microsoft gained 6.7%, Alphabet climbed 3.2%, and Meta added 1.4%.
